import pytest
from unittest.mock import mock_open, patch
import tomllib
import configparser
import os
from isort.settings import _get_config_data

@pytest.mark.parametrize("file_path, sections, expected", [
    ("valid_config.toml", ["section1", "section2"], {"section1_key": "value1", "section2_key": "value2", "source": "valid_config.toml"}),
    ("empty_config.toml", ["section1"], {}),
    ("valid_config.editorconfig", ["[*]"], {"indent": "    ", "line_length": 80, "source": "valid_config.editorconfig"}),
    ("valid_config.editorconfig", ["[non_existing_section]"], {}),
    ("special_config.editorconfig", ["[*]"], {"comment_prefix": ";;", "source": "special_config.editorconfig"}),
    ("invalid_format.txt", ["section"], {}),
    ("valid_config.toml", ["non_existing_section"], {})
])
def test_get_config_data(file_path, sections, expected):
    if file_path.endswith(".toml"):
        mock_data = {
            "section1": {"section1_key": "value1"},
            "section2": {"section2_key": "value2"}
        }
        with patch("builtins.open", mock_open(read_data=tomllib.dumps(mock_data))):
            # Simulating tomllib.load just for the purpose of this test.
            with patch("tomllib.load", return_value=mock_data):
                result = _get_config_data(file_path, sections)
                assert result == expected

    elif file_path.endswith(".editorconfig"):
        mock_lines = "[*]\nindent_style = space\nindent_size = 4\nmax_line_length = 80\n"
        with patch("builtins.open", mock_open(read_data=mock_lines)):
            result = _get_config_data(file_path, sections)
            assert result == expected

    else:
        with patch("builtins.open", mock_open(read_data="")):
            result = _get_config_data(file_path, sections)
            assert result == expected
